doc: History objects: revisions, transaction records and ref updates (ARCH1-R50, ARCH1-R45). No hashed type here holds a time field.

types.name: fabric.history.revision

fields.name: parents
fields.doc: Parent revision object ids; empty for the genesis revision.

fields.name: root
fields.doc: Object id of the root object (records trie and membership map).

fields.name: schema_set
fields.doc: Digest of the schema set the revision was written with.

fields.name: tx
fields.doc: Object id of the tx record that produced this revision.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Longest parent chain to the genesis revision (generation 0).

types.doc: A revision object (kind 6): parents, root, schema set, tx record and generation; no time field (ARCH1-R50).

types.name: fabric.history.origin

fields.name: subsystem
fields.doc: Subsystem that made the edit, as its owner number 01 to 12.

fields.name: epistemic
fields.doc: Epistemic class of the facts it writes.

types.doc: Where the facts of a transaction come from (ARCH1-R45).

types.name: fabric.history.tx_record

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: Actor id of the actor that committed the transaction.

fields.name: origin
fields.doc: Subsystem and epistemic class of the transaction.

fields.name: provenance
fields.doc: Provenance of the derived records it writes.

fields.name: patch
fields.doc: Object id of the patch object (kind 8) the transaction applied.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Client key that turns a retried commit into a no-op.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Human label shown in history and undo menus.

fields.name: undo_of
fields.doc: Tx id of the transaction this one undoes.

types.doc: A transaction record (kind 7): who committed what and why; no time field.

types.name: fabric.history.ref_update

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Ref name: 1 to 255 bytes of 0x21 to 0x7E.

fields.name: expected
fields.doc: Object id the ref holds now; absent when the ref must not exist.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Object id the ref moves to.

types.doc: One ref move of a commit batch: compare and set from expected to target.
